Ghoṣa(ka)
a Tokharian Sarvāstivādin Buddhist; one of the four masters of the Vaibhāṣika school; collaborator with Vasumitra.
--Abhidharmāmṛta (rasaśāstra). transl. into Chinese under Wei dynasty, 200-265 A. D. Nanjio 1278. Restored into Skt. by Śānti Bhikṣu.
Pt.. Viśvabhāratī

. See also NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 292a.
--Jñānotpādanaśāstra. mentioned in the Vibhāṣā.
Ref. to by Kamalaśīla in C. on Tattvasaṅgraha Vol. I. GOS. XXX. p. 504.

Ghoṣapurīmahārājñīcaritra
biography of Princess Ceruññaṭṭi Devī, mother of Prince Mānavikrama Kavirājakumāra or [Page279-a. Eṭṭan Tampūrān of Calicut; by Nīlakaṇṭha Śarman, Punnaśśeri.
Pt.. Pattambi, 1902.

Ghoṣayātrānāṭaka
in 10 acts. by ītalacandra Vidyābhūṣaṇa.
Pt.. Calcutta, 1885.

Ghoṣayātrā
or yudhiSThirAnRzaMsya nāṭaka. based on a. episode in the Mahābhārata. by Lakṣmaṇa Sūri.
Pt.. Madras, 1917.
